newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Fri shoulder power, Sat peak offered.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Fri shoulder power, Sat peak offered.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 PDT on Friday by 50 cents per megawatt hour (MWh) to $10.00, the agency said Thursday.
BPA also offered up to 200 MW of heavy-load power on Saturday at $16.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $17.00 for California-Oregon (COB) border sales.
The agency will pre-schedule sales through Saturday due to the upcoming holiday weekend. Sales for Sunday-Tuesday will be pre-scheduled on Friday.
BPA continued to offer Friday non-firm power for hours ending at 0100-0500 and 2400 at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm power between hours ending 0100-0700 and 2300-2400 on Saturday was offered at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Friday and Saturday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
